henry.title: Autumn Senses Poem
henry.intro: Poets use the five senses. Think about roasting green chile in fall: the smell, the crackle, the color!
steps: Look at a fall satellite picture on NASA Earth Observatory for ideas.
worksheet: List one fall word for each sense: see, hear, smell, taste, touch.
Write a 5-line poem, one line per sense.
Find a simile (like/as) or write one.
links: Look at the satellite pictures and find colors to use in your poem.

frankie.title: P is for Pumpkin!
frankie.intro: P makes the /p/ sound, like pop, pie, and pumpkin!
steps: Play a PBS KIDS reading game with a grown-up.
worksheet: Trace: P P P p p p
Circle the P word: pumpkin / apple
links: Pick a game with a grown-up and listen for the /p/ sound.
